move: checkerboard ticks on from edges, panel opens, berries drift, board inverts
how: A 12x12 grid of white cells on a blue 1080 square with alternating opacity forms a checkerboard border around an inner blue panel holding two italic serif rows, seven seeded SVG raspberries and two captions. The cells scale from 0 with back.out(2) in a grid stagger from the edges (first 8%), the panel scales 0 to 1 (expo.out) and the rows and captions rise through masks. Berries pop in from scale 0 with back.out(1.7) 0.09s apart and each glides along its own x/y/rotation path over 70% of the clip (sine.inOut). At 50% the cells invert their opacity from the centre outward. From 87% berries shrink with back.in(2), rows fly up, the panel scales to 0 and the cells scale out from the centre.
adapt: Change the two words, captions, berry SVG, the blue and the grid size; keep the from-edges grid stagger and the sine.inOut drift.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the 144 cells and seeded berries; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the panel at 0.06D, inversion at 0.5D, exit at 0.87D. Grid stagger options carry over; scope selectors to el.
caveats: 144 grid cells with two staggered tweens each is a large tween count
